name: Species Conservation Program
summary: Annual Ontario grants for habitat preservation and rehabilitation, threat mitigation and related conservation work for species at risk, open to NGOs, Indigenous groups, individuals and others. Land purchase is limited to conservation bodies, Indigenous communities and municipalities.

status.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: The fund is open to individuals and groups across Ontario, including: academic institutions conservation authorities corporations Indigenous communities and organizations individuals municipal and local governments non-government organizations

geography.quote: The fund is open to individuals and groups across Ontario

access.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.

window.quote: Each year, Ontario invests in projects through the Species Conservation Program that contribute to the protection and conservation of plants and animals at risk.
